_meta.note: Category-level master list for FSSAI 2026 — practical, lightweight dataset for compliance checks (category nodes include representative INS codes and usage notes).
_meta.source: Compiled from FSSAI Food Products Standards and Food Additives Regulations, 2011 and current amendments; official regulations index accessed 29 Sep 2026: https://www.fssai.gov.in/cms/food-safety-and-standards-regulations.php
_meta.document_excerpt: Plain (non-INS) ingredients used by the normalizer. `PERMITTED` here only means 'ordinary food ingredient, no additive rule needed' and is itself unverified.

ingredients.name: Cereals and Flours
ingredients.notes: Ordinary food ingredients; no additive rules unless fortified or modified.

representative_INS.name: Aspartame
representative_INS.usage_note: restricted; e.g., max 600 mg/L in soft drinks

representative_INS.name: Acesulfame K
representative_INS.usage_note: restricted; e.g., max 350 mg/L in beverages

representative_INS.name: Sucralose
representative_INS.usage_note: restricted; e.g., max 800 mg/L in beverages

representative_INS.name: Steviol Glycosides
representative_INS.usage_note: restricted; e.g., max 200 mg/kg in foods

ingredients.name: Fats and Oils
ingredients.notes: Use and labelling must follow FSSAI edible oil standards; trans-fat limits apply.

ingredients.name: Dairy and Milk Products
ingredients.notes: Comply with FSSAI dairy product standards and fortification rules where applicable.

ingredients.name: Seasonings and Spices
ingredients.notes: Natural ingredients; ensure purity and absence of prohibited colour/adulterants.

ingredients.name: Flavouring Substances
conditions: Use limited to permitted food categories and within any specified limits
Cannot be used to mask spoilage or adulteration

ingredients.name: Preservatives
conditions: Use within specified maximum limits per food category

ingredients.name: Colours
conditions: Use within specified limits; natural colours preferred where applicable

ingredients.name: Antioxidants
conditions: Declared on label; synthetic antioxidants have specified limits

ingredients.name: Emulsifiers and Stabilizers
conditions: Declared on label; some emulsifiers have category-specific limits

ingredients.name: Acidity Regulators
conditions: Declared on label where used; used to control pH and stability

ingredients.name: Thickeners and Gelling Agents
conditions: Declared on label; used for texture and mouthfeel

ingredients.name: Humectants
conditions: Declared on label; used to retain moisture and improve shelf life

ingredients.name: Proteins and Protein Ingredients
ingredients.notes: Allergen labelling required where applicable.

ingredients.name: Vegetables, Fruits and Derivatives
ingredients.notes: Sulphite/sulphur dioxide limits apply for dried fruits.

ingredients.name: Water
ingredients.notes: Water used as an ingredient must meet the applicable FSSAI drinking-water requirements.
ingredients.source: FSSAI Food Products Standards and Food Additives Regulations, 2011 and current amendments

ingredients.name: Tomato Ingredients
ingredients.notes: Tomato content and product identity must meet the applicable standard when sold as tomato sauce or tomato ketchup.
ingredients.source: FSSAI Food Products Standards and Food Additives Regulations, 2011 and current amendments

ingredients.name: Vinegar
ingredients.notes: Use the applicable vinegar standard; acetic acid declared as an additive is evaluated separately by INS rule.
ingredients.source: FSSAI Food Products Standards and Food Additives Regulations, 2011 and current amendments

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Iodised salt claims and composition must meet the applicable FSSAI standard.
ingredients.source: FSSAI Food Products Standards and Food Additives Regulations, 2011 and current amendments

ingredients.name: Sugar
ingredients.notes: Sugar is an ordinary ingredient; declared sweeteners and their permitted use levels are evaluated separately.
ingredients.source: FSSAI Food Products Standards and Food Additives Regulations, 2011 and current amendments

ingredients.name: Edible Vegetable Oil
ingredients.notes: The oil name, purity, blending and trans-fat requirements must meet the applicable FSSAI edible-oil standards.
ingredients.source: FSSAI Food Products Standards and Food Additives Regulations, 2011 and current amendments

ingredients.name: Mustard
ingredients.notes: Mustard is an allergen and must be declared according to FSSAI labelling requirements.
ingredients.source: FSSAI Food Products Standards and Food Additives Regulations, 2011 and current amendments

ingredients.name: Soy Ingredients
ingredients.notes: Soy is an allergen. Soy sauce composition and labelling must meet applicable FSSAI requirements.
ingredients.source: FSSAI Food Products Standards and Food Additives Regulations, 2011 and current amendments

ingredients.name: Chilli
ingredients.notes: Use only food-grade chilli ingredients and comply with applicable spice purity and contaminant requirements.
ingredients.source: FSSAI Food Products Standards and Food Additives Regulations, 2011 and current amendments

ingredients.name: Garlic and Onion
ingredients.notes: Use food-grade fresh, dried or processed garlic and onion ingredients.
ingredients.source: FSSAI Food Products Standards and Food Additives Regulations, 2011 and current amendments

ingredients.name: Lemon and Lime
ingredients.notes: Fruit juice or concentrate identity and composition must meet the applicable FSSAI standard.
ingredients.source: FSSAI Food Products Standards and Food Additives Regulations, 2011 and current amendments

ingredients.name: Tamarind
ingredients.notes: Use food-grade tamarind pulp, paste or concentrate with the applicable fruit-product requirements.
ingredients.source: FSSAI Food Products Standards and Food Additives Regulations, 2011 and current amendments

ingredients.name: Nuts, Seeds and Related Oils
ingredients.notes: Allergen labelling required; oil purity standards apply.

ingredients.name: Banned Substances
ingredients.notes: Strictly prohibited in food; presence triggers non-compliance and recall actions.
